report.question: Do any two keys in any contract schema differ only by case, and does any consumer parse JSON case-insensitively? The seeded failure class is a case-insensitive parser colliding on case-distinct keys. Enumerate every key across all schemas, detect case-collisions mechanically, and test each consumer's behaviour on a document containing duplicate and case-variant keys.
